title: A five-carbon rearrangement
hook: Count the atoms and trace their bonds.

knows: Condensed structural formulas and covalent bonds.
doesNotKnow: Both structures have formula C₅H₁₂, but their atoms connect differently. pentane and 2-methylbutane are constitutional isomers.

misconception: Different-looking structural drawings must represent different formulas or different compounds.
objective: Compare molecular formula and connectivity when classifying two structures.

claims.text: Structure A is pentane (C₅H₁₂); structure B is 2-methylbutane (C₅H₁₂). Both structures have formula C₅H₁₂, but their atoms connect differently. pentane and 2-methylbutane are constitutional isomers.
Constitutional isomers have the same molecular formula but different atomic connectivity.
The diagrams show condensed connectivity, not stereochemistry or molecular geometry.
Recall: What relationship do pentane and 2-methylbutane have? Both structures have formula C₅H₁₂, but their atoms connect differently. pentane and 2-methylbutane are constitutional isomers.
